name: Fortivor
description: Premium pre-workout. Blue Raspberry Watermelon. A formula built around clearly stated ingredient amounts.
details: Fortivor combines L-citrulline, beta-alanine, betaine anhydrous, taurine, L-tyrosine, Alpha-GPC, theobromine and caffeine sources totaling approximately 355 mg. The flavor is Blue Raspberry Watermelon. Serving size and usage directions are awaiting confirmation.

gallery.alt: Supplement Facts reproduced from the supplied black-and-gold label. The shown 18 g serving size is awaiting correction and is not approved dosing guidance.

warning: Approximately 355 mg total caffeine per serving, calculated from the two labeled caffeine sources. Also contains theobromine. For adults 18+ only. Do not combine with other caffeine or stimulant products. Not for children, pregnancy or nursing. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use, especially with medications, medical conditions or caffeine sensitivity. Use only according to the approved directions.
caffeineNote: Approximately 355 mg total caffeine per serving, calculated from 300 mg caffeine anhydrous plus 55 mg from 250 mg guarana extract standardized to 22% caffeine.
labelSource: Ingredient amounts transcribed from the product image and confirmed by the owner; owner-provided description confirms 355 mg total caffeine; Blue Raspberry Watermelon flavor retained as requested. Serving size is unresolved.

labelConsistencyIssues.message: Listed ingredients total 18.65 g before other ingredients, exceeding the declared 18 g serving. Owner correction requested; supplied amounts retained.

supplementFactsText: Serving size: awaiting confirmation. The supplied label shows 25 servings per container; the final serving count requires confirmation. Declared formula amounts: L-Citrulline 8,000 mg; Beta-Alanine 3,200 mg; Betaine Anhydrous 2,500 mg; Taurine 2,000 mg; L-Tyrosine 1,500 mg; Alpha-GPC (50%) 300 mg; Theobromine 300 mg; Caffeine Anhydrous 300 mg; Guarana Extract (22% Caffeine) 250 mg; Sodium (as Sodium Chloride) 300 mg. Other Ingredients: Citric Acid, Natural & Artificial Flavors, Silicon Dioxide, Sucralose, Acesulfame Potassium, Calcium Silicate.
